//: Server tsconfig. There is NO compile step: `tsx` runs the .ts files
directly (dev and start). tsc exists purely as the typechecker
moduleResolution 'bundler' matches how tsx resolves extension-less
ESM imports. If you ever switch to a real `tsc` build for production,
change module/moduleResolution to 'NodeNext' and add .js extensions
to relative imports - that's the one gotcha of this setup.
